tools.name: describe_symbol
tools.description: Describe one semantic symbol by stable id, qualified name, or name.

tools.name: find_symbol
tools.description: Find semantic declarations by exact name.

tools.name: get_diagnostics
tools.description: Return bounded Slang diagnostics, total_count, truncated and analysis scope. Unknown-module/package scope hints identify possible missing dependencies, never harmless errors. Syntax/type errors remain visible; completeness is not inferred.

tools.name: get_hierarchy
tools.description: Return the elaborated instance and generate hierarchy. root accepts an exact elaborated instance or generate-block path, or a top name.

tools.name: get_references
tools.description: Bounded source-level semantic references. kind read or write includes read_write accesses; kind port_connection filters port-binding context. No netlist inference.

tools.name: get_state_elements
tools.description: Signals written in always_ff; no reset or synthesis inference.

tools.name: inspect_instance
tools.description: Effective instance parameters and resolved source-level port connections, with optional children. Defaults to parameters and connections.

fields.description: Sections to return; omitted returns parameters and connections. Identity is always included.

parameter_names.description: Exact names to include, filtered before the section limit.

port_names.description: Exact names to include, filtered before the section limit.

tools.name: inspect_module
tools.description: Module declaration signature and optional elaborated usage sections. Defaults to parameters and ports.

fields.description: Sections to return; omitted returns parameters and ports. Identity is always included.

parameter_names.description: Exact names to include, filtered before the section limit.

port_names.description: Exact names to include, filtered before the section limit.

tools.name: list_instance_facts
tools.description: Selected effective parameters and resolved port connections for every elaborated instance of one module type. Optional parameter_names and port_names select exact names; limit bounds instances and fact_limit bounds each nested collection.

tools.name: list_instances
tools.description: Filter elaborated instances by type, exact name and path prefix.

tools.name: project_info
tools.description: Return build and elaboration information without rebuilding.

tools.name: project_load
tools.description: Compile one SystemVerilog top from explicit ordered source_files. Paths must be absolute and exist; source order and duplicates are preserved. Supply child modules, packages, include_directories and defines explicitly. Missing dependencies remain diagnostics. The top uses standalone parameter defaults; completeness is not verified.

single_unit.description: Compile ordered sources as one compilation unit, sharing macros and compilation-unit declarations. Set false for a separate compilation unit per file.
